source.name: synthetic, deterministic
source.sampling: 120 lists of 3–8 nouns, seed 11, half above five

task.name: count
task.instructions: Count the items in the list. Decide whether there are more than five.

criteria.more_than_5: The list contains six or more items.
criteria.five_or_fewer: The list contains five items or fewer.
